The next London SynBio Network event will be on Thursday the 4th of December. As usual, we will have 2x20 mins talks, followed by networking over drinks and snacks:

🧬 How to build a protein
Noah Sprent (Change Bio | Imperial)

💐 Engineering altruism: How metabolic exchanges shape synthetic microbial communities in bio-manufacturing
Diego Ruiz (Ledesma-Amaro Lab | Imperial)

📍 Location and time: Thursday the 4th of December at 18:00, City and Guilds Building - Room 640, Imperial College London (see this link to see how to get there). The event has step-free access and is open to anyone, but please register so reception has your details.

➡️ Register at: https://events.humanitix.com/london-synbio-network-12

🧬 London SynBio Network is organised by Early Career Researchers and hosts monthly meetups to bring Synbio folks from academia and industry together, providing an informal space to share ideas and ask for advice.
